data_categories: deployment artifacts (digests only — secrets never stored here)
sub_processors.encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit
sub_processors.rationale: Single source of truth for platform state. The model budget (spec §13) assumes EU jurisdiction; FSN1/NBG1 gives us that.

sub_processors.service: Stripe Billing + metered usage records (legacy opt-in)
sub_processors.data_region: US (Stripe default) — controller can opt into EU via Stripe account settings
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Stripe Data Processing Addendum (linked from Stripe Dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Legacy opt-in billing provider. We pass account-id + plan + metered usage; Stripe handles card data under its own PCI-DSS attestation. Processor never sees card numbers.

sub_processors.data_region: EU or US (Paddle entity selected by the merchant)
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Paddle Data Processing Addendum (linked from Paddle Dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Explicit compatibility provider for deployments that already use Paddle. Paddle Billing has no usage-summary endpoint, so ReconcileUsage returns ErrNotImplemented for Paddle accounts (issue #279).

sub_processors.service: Polar merchant of record + usage-based billing
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Polar Data Processing Addendum (linked from Polar organization dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Public-release merchant of record. Gregale sends customer email, plan, subscription metadata, and calendar-month net overage events; Polar handles payment data and applicable merchant-of-record tax obligations under its merchant-of-record model.

sub_processors.service: Resend transactional email transport + Svix-signed webhook (bounce / complaint / delivery events)
data_categories: subject + body of the transactional message
inbound bounce / complaint events: recipient email + bounce reason + provider event id
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Resend Data Processing Addendum (linked from Resend Dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Transactional email transport + inbound webhook. Outbound: account-holder-only email (no end-user PII). Inbound (issue #246 / ADR-115 §D.3): Resend POSTs bounce / complaint / delivery events to /v1/webhooks/resend, Svix HMAC-signed; payload carries recipient email + provider event id, no body or subject. The bounce handler (pkg/meter/bounce_handler.go) writes a mail_suppressions row + a mail.bounce_hard / mail.bounce_complaint audit row + advances dunning for hard bounces. Default in dev is 'log' (writes to slog; no third-party processing).

sub_processors.service: Postmark transactional email transport + bounce / spam-complaint webhook
data_categories: subject + body of the transactional message
inbound bounce / spam-complaint events: recipient email + bounce reason + message id
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Postmark Data Processing Addendum (linked from Postmark Dashboard)
sub_processors.rationale: Opt-in transactional email transport + inbound webhook. Production wires FAAS_MAIL_TRANSPORT=postmark; default in dev is 'log'. Inbound webhook parity with the Resend handler is a follow-up ADR — today only the Resend dispatch is wired (issue #246 acceptance item 8). Email bodies contain no end-user PII.

data_categories: encrypted Postgres dump (AES-256 / X25519-sealed via ADR-020)
sub_processors.encryption: Storage Box sees ciphertext only — encryption with operator's host X25519 age recipient happens BEFORE transit (ADR-020)
sub_processors.rationale: Off-host encrypted backups (DR drill requirement, SOC 2 CC7.5 / ISO 27001 A.5.29/A.5.30). The customer's own storage box is the Processor-side target; Processor holds the decryption key but does not access backup contents absent a Controller-initiated restore request.

data_categories: optional profile name and avatar URL
sub_processors.dpa_reference: Google Cloud Data Processing Addendum (linked from Google Cloud Console)
sub_processors.rationale: Account holders who choose Google login exchange the OAuth subject and a verified email — and the optional profile name and avatar URL — at POST /v1/auth/google/callback. No contact list, no Drive, no repo list. Scopes are openid email profile.

sub_processors.dpa_reference: GitHub Data Protection Addendum (linked from GitHub Settings)
sub_processors.rationale: Account holders who choose GitHub login exchange the GitHub user-id, primary verified email, and login handle — and the optional name and avatar URL — at POST /v1/auth/github/callback. No repo list, no contact list, no org list. Scopes are read:user user:email.

sub_processors.service: GitHub Checks API + install-token exchange (outbound from githubd)
sub_processors.dpa_reference: GitHub Data Protection Addendum (linked from GitHub Settings)
sub_processors.rationale: githubd daemon is the only outbound caller to api.github.com. Outbound traffic carries SHA-only commit metadata (Checks) and OAuth install-token exchange — no customer PII. Inbound webhook reception at POST /webhooks/github is HMAC-SHA-256 verified (X-Hub-Signature-256, constant-time compare) before any payload is consumed.
